# What the preview publishes, one path per line, relative to the repo root.
#
# Not the whole repository: GitHub Pages serves at most 1GB per site and the
# tree here is over 3GB — the home pages carry ~150MB of assets each. So a
# preview names the pages the current work is about, and stays small enough
# that every branch's preview can sit alongside the others.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# This branch publishes nothing. It is the design-system pass over every
# page, reviewed on a local server rather than a link, and the home page
# it started from carries 150MB of media — enough to push the previews
# site past its 900MB budget and fail the build for every branch.
# Name a page here when something on this branch needs sharing.
